fatal_reasons: The reports are supplemental boring investigations, not final construction as-built thickness surveys.
Landfill 1 measured points are no closer than about 47.6 m, so a 30-40 m depth zone is not independently bounded by multiple nearby measurements.
Landfill 2 has no defensible deep measured zone; mapped greater-than-24-inch areas depend on interpolation and Note 1 borings where fill was not encountered.
The reports provide no numerical uncertainty for interpolated isopach boundaries.
Using the colored map polygons as exact depth zones would convert sparse exploratory measurements into unsupported geometry.
